tests.name:
bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; export DSH_HOME="$(mktemp -d)"; START=$(date +%s); npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8 plugin --profile smoke add dsh-plugin-image-mind@0.2.0; END=$(date +%s); echo "INSTALL_SECONDS=$((END-START))"; OUT=$(npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8 --profile smoke --dump-config); printf "%s
" "$OUT" | grep -q "image-mind"; printf "%s
" "$OUT" | grep -q "vision-runtime"; test -d "$DSH_HOME/profiles/smoke/node_modules/dsh-plugin-image-mind"; test -d "$DSH_HOME/profiles/smoke/node_modules/@ran-sh/dsh-vision"; npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8 plugin --profile smoke remove dsh-plugin-image-mind; OUT2=$(npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8 --profile smoke --dump-config || true); if printf "%s
" "$OUT2" | grep -qE "vision-runtime|image-mind"; then echo "stale bundle layer remains after remove" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo "RC8_COMPAT_SMOKE=PASS"'
tests.evidence: A newly created temporary DSH_HOME and exact @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8 were used. The official plugin add command produced no output and remained in dependency resolution for at least 647 seconds, so the task-owned process tree was terminated at the bounded 10-minute threshold (exit 1). INSTALL_SECONDS was never emitted; install completion, dump-config composition, package-directory checks, official removal, and stale-layer checks were therefore not reached. The Windows bash.cmd wrapper first misparsed shell pipes, so the unchanged script body was rerun through its backing Git Bash executable.

blockers: Exact DSH 0.1.0-rc.8 dependency resolution did not complete within 10 minutes in either the version probe or isolated plugin installation, preventing runtime compatibility and uninstall verification.
notes: Observed versions: Node v24.18.1; npm 11.16.0; DSH version unavailable because the exact pinned npx command did not complete.
Dependency resolution did not complete without timeout. The isolated install elapsed at least 647 seconds before termination and never emitted INSTALL_SECONDS.
The smoke command exported a newly generated temporary DSH_HOME and used profile smoke; no user DSH profile was targeted.
No API key or credential was read or exposed, and no paid real-provider vision call was made.
Non-blocking repository-check warnings included npm's future removal of the single-hyphen -ws flag, ES2024 target compatibility notices, and Node DEP0190.
No product source, tests, scripts, CI, package metadata, README, or docs/compatibility.md files were modified.
